class.name: NetwService
class.brief_description: A [Node] that registers itself as a service of its [member Node.multiplayer] while it is in the tree.
class.description:
Get it with [method NetwSession.service]. Override [method _service_entered] and [method _service_exiting] for setup and cleanup. [codeblock] class_name MatchClock extends NetwService
func _service_type() -> Script: return MatchClock
func _service_entered(session: NetwSession) -> void: session.entered.connect(_on_entered)
func _service_exiting(session: NetwSession) -> void: session.entered.disconnect(_on_entered) [/codeblock] A node that extends another class can call [method register] and [method unregister] instead.

method.name: _service_entered
method.description: Called after the service registers, when it enters the tree. Not called in the editor, or when [method _should_register] returns [code]false[/code].

method.name: _service_exiting
method.description: Called before the service unregisters, when it leaves the tree. Undo [method _service_entered] here.

method.name: _service_type
method.description: Return the type to register the service as, such as a base class. [code]null[/code] uses the script itself. A service replaces any other registered as the same type.

method.name: _should_register
method.description: Return [code]false[/code] to not register, for example behind a feature flag. [code]true[/code] by default.

method.name: register
method.description: Registers [param service] with its [member Node.multiplayer], as [param type] or its own script. Call [method unregister] when it leaves the tree. Does nothing when [member Node.multiplayer] is not a [NetwMultiplayer]. [codeblock] func _enter_tree() -> void: NetwService.register(self) [/codeblock]

method.name: unregister
method.description: Reverses [method register], with the same [param type]. [codeblock] func _exit_tree() -> void: NetwService.unregister(self) [/codeblock]
